scope: Static parsing of actual measured module bytes; no module or generated code execution.
normalization: Remove each printed instruction address and the numerical address before a symbolic <target>; retain mnemonic, operands, symbolic target and target-relative offset. Relocation tables are not normalized or claimed identical.
limits: Same text bytes before relocation do not prove same runtime placement or relocations.
Static differences cannot quantify their measured performance contribution.
No per-point instruction samples or causal attribution experiment was performed.
